nodes.label: Dual-Layer Storage Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separates cloud-safe readable Markdown and append-only CRDT oplogs in Google Drive from the ephemeral local SQLite turbo-index on SSD so cloud sync never corrupts binary B-trees.

nodes.label: SQLite Embedded Index Decision
nodes.rationale: In-process SQLite (WAL, 256MB mmap, FTS5, JSONB) runs at ~0.005 ms per lookup vs client-server MariaDB (~0.2-1.0 ms IPC overhead) and keeps idle RAM below 5 MB.

nodes.label: Fractional Indexing (sort_order REAL)
nodes.rationale: Allows O(1) drag-and-drop block reordering by updating only one row's sort_order instead of renumbering every sibling block.
